question: Does spec-event peak brightness alone partition the 10 m048 face groups into clean face-identity tiers, and what cohort coverage do those tiers give?
hypothesis: Per-face spec-event magnitude distributions are well-separated by face area, so brightness alone shortlists candidate body-frame faces for any LC peak.
narrative_md: Per-face spec-event mag distributions are well-separated by face area, partitioning the 10 face groups into 4 clean brightness tiers: T1_X (mag<6, ±X, 99.4% purity), T2_YZ (6-7, ±Y/±Z, 97.7%), T3_any (7-8, 100%), T4_D (8-9, dishes, 97.4%). This is the structured IC-generation primitive the survey was missing: magnitude alone shortlists 2-8 candidate body faces per LC peak. Cohort coverage: 45/100 with ≥1 T1, 73/100 with ≥2 distinct tiers, 19/100 with zero classifiable peaks (Sobol fallback). Tier thresholds stored as mag_abs at D_REF_KM=38649.2 for portability.
